span.p:
5-Metric Anomaly Evaluation Engine
• Price Rise % (15D High vs T-180 Base)
• Price Z-Score (15D Return vs 180D Normal)
• Volume Z-Score (15D Volume vs 180D Normal)
• Upper Circuit Persistence (Days ≥ 90% Band)
• 180-Day New High Breakout Days

• Watchlist Inclusion Flagging
